value.rationale: Exact local reversible-arc robustness on all strong orientations of canonical cubic Q3, equivalently simplicity of every vertex of canonical five-dimensional octahedral graphical zonotope, with absence of degree 7 and full symmetry orbit census. This natural exact degree invariant is strictly finer than known total count 426, and is useful for describing local state mobility and polytope degeneracy; no general theorem is asserted.
